how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:76160:title: Stalk With The Earthmother
rows.quest:76160:details:0:
I speak to you from your future, when the ⟦E15⟧ faces threats you cannot imagine. Since the others cannot see me, I rely on you to learn my skills and pass them to the tribe.

Maybe your skills lie with poisons, not disguises. The Harpies to the north nest in a tree which produces a resin of potent toxicity. Gather the fallen cones around the nests, then crush them into a salve. When applied to a blade this salve will sear your ⟦E16⟧'s ⟦E17⟧ into their flesh and turn their blood to salt.
rows.quest:76160:progress:0: Be careful with the salve once you are finished, ⟦17⟧ . Even skin contact could be quite painful.
rows.quest:76160:completion:0: ⟦18⟧ , this is not the venomous salve I asked for. What you have brought me is pine nut butter. Are you sure you followed my instructions? ⟦19⟧ This will be of far more use spread on some spice bread than on a dagger. Although you would be quite formidable against a foe with a nut allergy.
rows.quest:76240:title: Stalk With The Earthmother
rows.quest:76240:details:0:
I have one last idea that may lead us to success. I still feel there is hidden ⟦E18⟧ in you, but let us try and coax it out with a less direct approach.

Go and procure a ⟦E19⟧, then bring it back here. ⟦E20⟧ these daggers to clean and fillet it. Do not think too hard - do what comes naturally.
rows.quest:76240:progress:0: Do you have something for me?
rows.quest:76240:completion:0: That was quite a display, ⟦20⟧ . Not the rogueish precision I hoped for, but you possess an impressive ambidexterity. ⟦21⟧ I see now that you will not be the one to train my people in the subtle arts, but there is one thing I can teach you. Good luck on your travels, ⟦22⟧ . The ⟦E15⟧ will need heroes like you.
rows.quest:86784:title: Sticks and Bones
rows.quest:86784:obj:0: Collect 6 Dry Branches and bring them to ⟦E21⟧ Shackleton.
rows.quest:86784:details:0: My associate ⟦E21⟧ Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."
rows.quest:86784:details:1: If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.

rows.quest:93746:details:1: Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of ⟦E24⟧ into his heart.
